name: Rashid
def: Emirati micro rover built to study lunar dust and plasma, lost when the ispace Hakuto-R lander crashed in April 2023.
body: Rashid was the first lunar rover designed and built in the Arab world, assembled at the Mohammed bin Rashid Space Centre in Dubai. It carried two high resolution cameras, a microscopic camera, a thermal imager and a Langmuir probe to study regolith properties, dust adhesion and the plasma environment, with test patches of different materials on its wheels. Communication with the Hakuto-R Mission 1 lander was lost seconds before touchdown on 25 April 2023 and the spacecraft crashed near Atlas crater.
facts: First lunar rover designed and built in the Arab world
Lost in the Hakuto-R Mission 1 landing failure
specs: Four wheel drive with material test patches on the wheels
Two high resolution cameras, microscopic camera, thermal imager, Langmuir probe
Teleoperated from Dubai through the lander relay
